title: The Society Atlas — designed regional autumn ambience
disclaimer: Designed regional autumn ambience. Not live weather, a forecast, or an assertion about the weather in a historical encounter.

sources.title: NWS CWSU Nashua Weather Impact Playbook — Boston climatology
sources.scope: The Boston climate discussion describes maritime moderation and changing fair, cloudy, and wet weather. The game selects gentle examples; it does not simulate observed dates.

sources.title: NWS Philadelphia/Mount Holly — Philadelphia climate normals
sources.scope: Local seasonal normals anchor a cooling autumn setting; breeze and leaf motion are artistic choices.

sources.title: NWS Philadelphia/Mount Holly — Trenton climate normals
sources.scope: Trenton is a nearby regional reference for Princeton, not a campus weather station. The game uses crisp autumn light rather than claiming a measured campus condition.

sources.title: NWS Indianapolis — 1991–2020 climate normals, including Bloomington
sources.scope: Central Indiana seasonal temperature and precipitation context; the chosen soft shower is fictional.

sources.title: NWS Indianapolis — frost and freeze dates for central Indiana
sources.scope: Includes Bloomington and the region’s autumn cooling. No specific game day or historical temperature is inferred.

sources.title: NOAA/NWS Technical Memorandum WR-261 — overview of Los Angeles climate
sources.scope: The overview discusses a dry-summer/rainy-winter regime, marine-layer influence and light sea breezes. The game chooses a mild dry interval and faint coastal haze, with no snow.

sources.title: NWS San Francisco Bay Area — Ask the Expert
sources.scope: Explains coastal marine fog and seasonal storm-track changes. Palo Alto is not equated with foggier coastal San Francisco; only a light marine haze is used.

sources.title: NWS Northern Indiana — South Bend climate
sources.scope: Discusses Lake Michigan influence, cool-season cloudiness, and a snow season beginning in late autumn. The game occasionally uses a few gentle flakes without accumulation.

sources.title: NWS New York — Central Park climate normals and extremes
sources.scope: 1991–2020 seasonal and monthly climate context. Central Park is a regional reference; the Columbia scene’s drizzle is an authored choice.

sources.title: NWS State College — local climate resources
sources.scope: Provides State College climate references and central Pennsylvania autumn freeze context.

sources.title: NWS State College — snowfall and seasonal water resources
sources.scope: Documents central Pennsylvania snowfall climatology and first accumulating snow context. Sparse scenic flurries are not a claim about the date of a visit.

sources.title: NWS St. Louis — Regional Climate Summary
sources.scope: Describes increased autumn variability and dry intervals between weather systems. The game uses passing cloud and brighter intervals, not severe weather.

sources.title: NWS Pittsburgh — November climatic data, 1991–2020 normals
sources.scope: Anchors a cool late-autumn setting. Soft overcast and light drizzle are authored scenic examples, not a reconstruction of 1978.
